# Preface

This book teaches the `tinynet` repository: what it is for, how it is built, and the ideas it rests on. It is written for readers who know Python and want to understand backpropagation through a real, runnable implementation.

Chapter 1 gives the big picture. Chapter 2 teaches backpropagation from first principles and then maps every equation onto the code.

**How to read the citations.** A reference such as [[tinynet/model.py:23-31]] links to those exact lines at the commit this book was written from.
